$comment: The colour roles of a panel (spec 2026-11-06-one-panel-derivation-curves-and-bar-group.md §7.10): every colour a panel description makes a surface draw, named once here under the console's token names, each with its family (omx look §2(i): theme, accent, fixed, state), the floor its value must clear against the grounds it is drawn on, and ONE default value. The values are each host's: the console's tokens.css sets every role in every theme, Zynthian's palette table maps onto every role; the MOD GUI, whose host supplies nothing, wears these defaults, the dark look `look` names (tools/look.mjs derives tools/look.json from them). A ground carries no floor: it is what the others are measured on. Finish and selection colours (knob and fader-cap metal, slot, fill, glass grid, focus ring, shade, selected) are a host's chrome and not roles.
